create_obstacle_manager: create an ObstacleManager instance with a PyBullet client, timestep, and up vector for managing physics obstacles
launch_obstacle: launch a single Obstacle object into the PyBullet simulation with specified shape, mass, position, and velocity
throw_obstacles: throw multiple obstacles toward a target position with randomized launch directions and velocities
update_obstacles: update obstacle positions and velocities each timestep, removing expired obstacles from the simulation
render_obstacles: render all active obstacles in the simulation with fading alpha based on remaining duration
